through_line: Agents are gaining persistent memory and self-composing skill loops between sessions.
prior_through_lines: On-device AI crossed an architectural threshold, not just a marketing one.
evidence_paragraph: hermes-agent ships a built-in learning loop that synthesizes skills from completed tasks and persists them across runs; openhuman stores a full memory tree in Obsidian-compatible markdown with a background subconscious loop that updates between sessions; skills frames 17 Claude Code skills as a closed feedback system where diagnose, zoom-out, and improve-codebase-architecture feed each other. All three treat memory and composability as first-class infrastructure, not add-ons.
counter_signal: proofshot and react-doctor show that external, human-readable verification is still needed because agents cannot reliably audit their own output.
